Name: Wildflour's Romantic Garden Farm
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/xOnA2oQ.png[/img]

The spiritual successor to my Fancy Garden Farm - Romantic Garden Farm ! 

A new custom farm map with tons of space for crops, flowers, bee houses and animals in a romantic English garden style

Features 4 different color schemes! Choose from Marble, Goth, Pastel and Mermaid to customize the style of your farm!

Pair with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17577]H&W Romantic Furniture[/url]﻿ to decorate your perfect Romantic Garden Farm!

Building Mods in Screenshots - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2110]Hudson Valley Buildings[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]Idaida's Buildings[/url]﻿, [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Buildings[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3796]Flowery Pink Houses[/url]﻿

[/size][list]
[/list][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img][/size]

[size=4]Hime for being my other half and inspiring me to do this map[/size]

[size=4]SDV modding discord community for their continued love and support and friendship <3[/size]
[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img][/size]

[size=4]This is a custom farm map so it does not replace any other farm map, which should make it highly compatible with other map mods since you don't have to choose which one replaces which standard farm map. [/size]
[size=5][b]
Want to change your existing farm to this one? Check out this mod to do so! -->

[/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873][size=5][b]Easy Farm Switcher[/b][/size][/url]﻿
[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img][/size]

[size=4]A few folks have asked and I now have a kofi if you feel like you’d like to contribute towards the mods and me and my kitties.

[url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Ko-fi.com/wildflourmods[/url]

It's absolutely [u]not required ever[/u] to enjoy my mod which will always be free for all; but I thank each and every one of you who has already donated and perhaps will donate <3[/size][/center]
